mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_rule (rule_name, keyword, log_level, threshold, time_window, alert_level, enabled) VALUES (#{ruleName}, #{keyword}, #{logLevel}, #{threshold}, #{timeWindow}, #{alertLevel}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_rule SET rule_name = #{ruleName}, keyword = #{keyword}, log_level = #{logLevel}, threshold = #{threshold}, time_window = #{timeWindow}, alert_level = #{alertLevel}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_name, keyword, log_level, threshold, time_window, alert_level, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM alert_rule WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, rule_name, keyword, log_level, threshold, time_window, alert_level, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM alert_rule ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, rule_name, keyword, log_level, threshold, time_window, alert_level, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM alert_rule WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
